Name: More Sensible Juices
Author: ncarigon
Description:
Why doesn't orange juice exist in a world that includes oranges and juices?

Why does it take 4 days to juice a vegetable?

Why does fruit ferment in a keg but vegetables don't?

The new machine [b]Juice Press[/b] has been created to alleviate these oddities, which becomes available at [u]Farming level 4[/u] (alongside the Preserves Jar). It will quickly press both fruits and vegetables into flavored juices. To compensate for the quicker processing time, juice is now worth less than normal. It is a good option to quickly and modestly increase profits on crops that wouldn't usually be worth the time to process other ways, while still being less profitable than using the Preserves Jar.

[u]Fruit juice[/u] is now required to [u]make wine[/u]. [u]Wheat juice[/u] is now required to [u]make beer.[/u] H[u]ops juice[/u] is now required to make [u]pale ale[/u].

Includes configuration settings to toggle the recipes for beer, pale ale, and wine to their normal (keg-only) versions, as well as the ability to enable item quality inheritance or item quality to potentially double output quantity.

Crafting the Juice Press requires 45 wood, 45 stone, 10 hardwood, and 1 iron bar - keeping it similar to the cheese press recipe.
